# Shinigami Shell 0.0.1

This release candidate updates the launcher, Wallpapers, Quick Access, and Indicators, and aligns the packaging checks with the supported upgrade history.

## Changes

- The transparent Shinigami launcher mark follows the same size, alignment, and foreground styling as the other launcher icons. The original logo in the Plugins summary is unchanged.
- The Wallpapers widget uses the standard V1 capsule. In the plugin catalog, **Shinigami Wallpapers** has an image icon and **Shinigami OneDrive** has a cloud icon.
- Quick Access keeps its theme, screenshot, and video pickers and no longer includes an Idle Inhibitor toggle. Indicators retains Stay Awake and uses the former Quick Access idle glyph in place of the three-dot marker in V1 and V2.
- Repair preserves a healthy managed widget layout by default. Supported source predecessors are matched by their exact revision and payload digests.

## Version reset

`0.0.1` sorts below `0.2.5`. Existing installations on a higher version cannot use the normal update path. A transition requires an explicitly admitted target and the [documented downgrade procedure](../../docs/install.md#roll-back-a-package-version), including a backup.

See the [installation and update guide](../../docs/install.md) and [changelog](../../CHANGELOG.md) for details.
